description: A rust-red knee-length Vlandian wool cote over a cream linen shirt, with restrained gold-brown geometric woven edging at the neckline, cuffs and hem. A dark leather belt with small metal plaques and a simple side pouch secures the waist. A dark brown shoulder mantle with matching borders fastens by a round bronze brooch. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the everyday minor-lord outfit.
